name: Morty's Cafe Roasted Turkey, Bacon & Provolone Sandwich on Sourdough
whyItWorks: Lean sliced turkey breast and naturally low-lactose provolone cheese on toasted sourdough bread is much lighter and gentler than a fried basket or spicy burger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey & Provolone Sandwich on sourdough or white bread, holding raw tomatoes, red onions, and sprouts.
watchOuts: Ask for mayo or pesto-free spread on the side
